Samridhdhi Trust Empowers out-of-school migrant children to become school-ready and job-ready through education and holistic support. Bronze Certified 2023 FCRA 80G 12A Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Is this your profile? Edit now . Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Health Education Child & Youth Development Secondary Sectors Formal Education Child Rights Financials 2017 Total Income Rs. 30,000,247 Total Expenses Rs. 29,169,606 Program Expenses Rs. 29,169,606 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. 2018 Total Income Rs. 37,529,156 Total Expenses Rs. 35,809,129 Program Expenses Rs. 35,809,129 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. Geographies Served Programs Bridge Programs District Bangalore New Delhi District Bangalore New Delhi Many out-of-school children aged 6-14 years belong to migrant labour communities and un-notified slums across Bangalore, Pune and Delhi NCR. Their families are often engaged in waste picking and waste segregation, construction labour, domestic work, begging, street vending, petty shops and other menial jobs. Being interstate migrants (speaking Hindi, Bengali, Assamese, Oriya, Nepali, Telugu, etc.), the children do not relate to the local language and cannot integrate into government schools. Instead, the children take care of their younger siblings (babies and toddlers) while their parents are at work or manage household chores. Some are caught up in in rag picking, drug abuse, violence, illegal and harmful activities. They are afraid to travel even a couple of kilometres to reach school. Many have never been to a school. Milestones & Track Record Samridhdhi Trust has established 5 bridge schools in Bengaluru and NCR, enrolled over 4,000 children in bridge schools since 2010, and integrated 1,710 children into mainstream schools. --> --> Leadership Team Srinivasan Latha Chairman RAJENDRA HEROOR RAI Trustee Nilanjan Paul Choudhury Trustee Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAJTS7160A Registration Number MDP-4-00115-2010-11 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2018/0220851 --> 80G AAJTS7160AF20214 12A AAJTS7160AE20214 FCRA 94421611 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2009 Demographies Served Children --> Impact Over 4,000 children have been enrolled in Samridhdhi's bridge schools since 2010, with 1,710 integrated into mainstream schools and 30 graduates now pursuing undergraduate degrees.
